How More Loot differs from Loot
Same 101 base items · same 16 suffixes · same 68 name prefixes · same 18 name suffixes — identical vocabulary, different token IDs (#8001+). With 16× more bags, rarity thresholds scale: Common ≥6,124 · Uncommon ≥1,225 · Rare ≥180 · Epic ≥2 · Mythic =1. Named items are far more prevalent and Mythic items number 24,366 vs 5,235 in Loot.
